notablePrerequisites:
Thornbite Staff attached to Drafna.
Drafna does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Cast Su-Chi Cave Guard by paying {8}.
Holding priority, activate Drafna's second ability by paying {3} and tapping it, copying the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell.
Resolve the copy of the Su-Chi Cave Guard spell, creating a token copy of Su-Chi Cave Guard.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Su-Chi Cave Guard token.
The token Su-Chi Cave Guard dies, triggering itself and Drafna.
Resolve the Su-Chi Cave Guard trigger, adding eight {C}.
Resolve the Drafna trigger, untapping it.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, milling any player eight cards.
Repeat from step 2.
